摘要只写「这一章发生什么、主角状态怎么变」，一句话；钩子写「结尾让人翻页的那一下: The summary is one line: what happens in this chapter and how the protagonist's state changes. The hook is "the beat at the end that makes them turn the page".
粘榜单文本进来 —— 一行一本，名次在前、书名在后，中间或后面跟题材与数字。: Paste the ranking text — one book per line, rank first, title after, with genre and numbers in the middle or at the end.
粘一本别人的书进来，当场切章、算字数与对话比、判章末钩子、抽剧情点。: Paste someone else's book and it splits chapters on the spot, counts words and dialogue ratio, judges chapter-end hooks, and extracts plot points.
章名取正文首行（形如「第X回 标题」），不会在正文里重复一遍。EPUB 自带目录: The chapter name comes from the first line of the body (like "Chapter X — Title") and is not repeated inside the body. EPUB includes a table-of-contents page; DOCX uses Song typeface, first-line indent and 1.5 line spacing.
章末那一下还没写: The end-of-chapter beat is not written yet

账本里没有新地点: No new places in the ledger

这四件事由本机已安装的 oh-story 技能承担。长夜只负责把任务说清楚，然后: These four tasks are handled by the oh-story skills installed on this machine. Nightwrite only states the task clearly, then hands it to the agent in the conversation.

只报告不改：省略号用「……」还是「...」是风格选择，替作者决定就是改风格。: Report only, never change: whether to use "……" or "..." for ellipsis is a style choice, and deciding for the author means changing their style.
只查不改：长夜是本地开发版，升级方式是改完源码再同步到 profile，不需要: Check only, never change: Nightwrite is a local dev build — you upgrade by editing the source and syncing to the profile, no npm install needed. Query results are cached for 6 hours, and misses for 10 minutes, so opening settings never stalls.
只有「拦住」这一档才需要指定哪些目录不许直接改。: Only the "Block it" setting needs you to say which directories may not be edited directly.
中心是主角，连线颜色按「定位」自动上色（敌红 / 盟绿 / 亲琥珀）。点节点可改: The protagonist is at the centre; link colours follow "position" automatically (enemy red / ally green / kin amber). Click a node to edit it.
主题记在 localStorage，只影响长夜这一层，不动宿主界面。: The theme is stored in localStorage and only affects the Nightwrite layer — the host UI is untouched.
主线目标，越具体越好: The main-line goal — the more concrete the better
抓到了，先看一眼再点解析: Got it — take a look, then hit parse
